Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details, if that's all right.
Q: Understood. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving on a multi-lane road in Baytown, Texas, heading toward the freeway. Traffic was moderate and the
lanes were fairly wide.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was changing lanes to the right because the lane ahead had slowed. I checked my mirror and saw nothing close,
so I signaled and started to move over.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point?
A: Not until it was already alongside me. I heard a loud scrape and felt my car shove to the left. I didn't see it coming
up in my blind spot.
Q: Which part of your vehicle made contact with the other car?
A: The right side of my car, near the rear door and the back panel. The other car's left side was damaged too, from
what I could see afterward.
Q: Did you or the other driver stop after the collision?
A: Yes, we both pulled onto the shoulder. We exchanged information and the other driver seemed shaken but okay.
Q: You mentioned an injury. Where do you feel it, and when did you first notice it?
A: My right knee. It hit the steering column or the door frame when the car jolted. I felt pain almost right away, and it
got worse over the next day or two.
Q: Have you seen a medical provider for the knee?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same week and I've been following up with my own doctor since then. They've
recommended imaging and some physical therapy.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your account?
A: Only that I was trying to be careful and I signaled before moving over. That's everything I can recall right now.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "reason": one short sentence.
